
                    ╔══════════════════════════════════════╗
                    ║   PCBoard 15.4 Revival — Features    ║
                    ╚══════════════════════════════════════╝


    NEW IN 15.4 REVIVAL
    ═══════════════════

    PCBoard 15.4 Revival is the community continuation of Clark
    Development Company's PCBoard BBS. It includes every feature
    from the unreleased 15.4b beta plus new capabilities for
    running PCBoard in the internet era.


    FROM CLARK'S 15.4b BETA
    ───────────────────────

    These features were developed by Clark Development but never
    officially released. 15.4 Revival completes and ships them:

    •  Personal PSA (Public Service Announcement) system
    •  Enhanced PPL 3.40 with new functions and operators
    •  Improved caller security and validation
    •  Updated PCBSETUP with new configuration options
    •  OS/2 32-bit native PCBOARD2.EXE
    •  Extended USERS.INF fields
    •  New @-code display variables
    •  Conference improvements


    NEW IN 15.4 REVIVAL (NOT IN CLARK'S 15.4b)
    ───────────────────────────────────────────

    Internet Services (pcbis.exe):

    •  Telnet server — accept callers over TCP/IP, no modem needed
       Replaces the modem pool entirely. Each telnet connection is
       bridged to a PCBoard node. Callers appear in Who's Online
       and Last Callers just like modem users.

    •  BinkP mailer — FidoNet over TCP/IP (FSP-1018)
       Send and receive FidoNet netmail and echomail without a
       modem or phone line. Integrates with QFront for toss/scan.
       Poll uplinks on a configurable schedule.

    •  FTP server — file area access over the internet
       Sysops and callers can browse and download from your file
       areas using any FTP client. Reads DLPATH.LST for directory
       mapping. Supports anonymous or PCBoard user authentication.

    •  HTTP server — your BBS on the web
       Serves a static web page with your BBS information. Built-in
       dynamic pages show who's online, last callers, and file area
       listings. No web server software needed.

    •  SMTP outbound — email validation for new users
       Sends validation emails to new callers automatically. Works
       with any SMTP relay. Queue-based — if the relay is down,
       messages are held and retried.

    •  All protocols run in one daemon with a single config file
       (pcbis.cfg). The sysop console shows live connection stats
       for every protocol.


    Build System:

    •  All 12 binaries rebuilt from source — no binary-only components
    •  Open compiler toolchain: OpenWatcom 2.0 (openwatcomirc fork)
    •  No Borland/Embarcadero dependency
    •  DOS + OS/2 targets from a single source tree
    •  GitHub Actions CI — every commit is verified
    •  Full source code available at github.com/verta1878/pcbrevival


    Toolchain:

    •  openwatcomirc — custom OpenWatcom 2.0 fork
       Cross-compiles from Linux to DOS 16-bit, DOS 32-bit, OS/2,
       and Win32. Includes C and C++ compilers, linker, assembler,
       and all runtime libraries. Built from source on Linux.

    •  Future: Linux native PCBoard via openwatcomirc's GCC backend
       The same C source code that builds for DOS will also target
       Linux x86_64 via ELF64 output. One codebase, all platforms.


    COMPATIBILITY
    ─────────────

    15.4 Revival is fully compatible with:

    •  PCBoard 15.2 and 15.3 data files
    •  Existing DOOR programs (DOOR.SYS, PCBOARD.SYS)
    •  PPL scripts (.PPE files) compiled with PPLC 3.x
    •  PCBoard ANSI/color codes and @-codes
    •  Existing user databases (USERS, USERS.INF)
    •  Existing message bases and conference structures
    •  Existing file areas and DLPATH.LST
    •  QWK/QWKE mail packets
    •  FidoNet .PKT format (via QFront/BinkP)


    BINARIES INCLUDED
    ─────────────────

    DOS (11 binaries):
        PCBOARDM.EXE    Main BBS engine (386+COMM multitasker)
        PCBOARD.EXE     Non-386 overlay version
        LOCAL.EXE        Local login mode
        PCBSETUP.EXE     Setup and configuration utility
        PCBSM.EXE       System manager
        PPLC.EXE         PPL 3.40 script compiler
        MKPCBTXT.EXE     Text/prompt file generator
        UUIN.EXE         UUCP mail import
        UUOUT.EXE        UUCP mail export
        UUUTIL.EXE       UUCP utilities
        UUXFER.EXE       UUCP file transfer

    OS/2 (1 binary):
        PCBOARD2.EXE     OS/2 32-bit native BBS engine

    Internet Services (1 binary):
        PCBIS.EXE        Telnet + BinkP + FTP + HTTP + SMTP daemon


    KNOWN LIMITATIONS
    ─────────────────

    •  No SSH — use stunnel or an SSH-to-telnet proxy if needed
    •  No TLS for telnet — same workaround as above
    •  HTTP server is basic — static files + a few dynamic endpoints
    •  FTP does not support TLS/FTPS
    •  SMTP is outbound only — pcbis is not a mail server
    •  OS/2 PCBOARD2.EXE requires OpenWatcom runtime


    GETTING HELP
    ────────────

    Source code and issue tracker:
        https://github.com/verta1878/pcbrevival

    The software outlives the hardware.
